name: Tsukushi
source:
An elementary school student who is fully absorbed in gathering information with the goal of becoming a "fine man." You are constantly indebted to his unique information network. Although he says bratty things at times, he is very considerate of his older sister. He's actually Hibiya's mentor!?

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
